objective: Reach matched, publishable CVPR evidence for strict-locality residential floorplan editing: preserve the strong oracle-control and native-generation branches, close the predicted-control identity gap, validate walls/openings through real consumers, run matched baselines and statistics, and freeze a one-shot test without touching chips or FloorSet.

metric_tiers.rplan_generation_conditioned: Boundary and entrance are supplied. Five-seed Room IoU 0.67587, Wall F1 0.67590, watertightness 0.99961. This is not predicted-control editing.
metric_tiers.oracle_control_editing: Declared edit regions and outside freezing are allowed. Strong locality/Delta metrics here are an upper bound and cannot be reported as predicted-control SOTA.
metric_tiers.predicted_control_generation: Target-free native raster controls are predicted. Current comparative fidelity remains materially lower and is the primary SOTA blocker.
metric_tiers.control_gated_local_delta: A constrained edit renderer with declared locality controls. Strong Delta-IoU does not imply free-text or imperfect-control robustness.
metric_tiers.free_text_editing: Requires predicted intent, edit region, typed actions, abstention, and matched executable competition. Not yet promoted.

training_ladder.contract_smoke: One real batch, finite loss/gradients, canonical decode, token round trip, and stage consumer checks.
training_ladder.mechanism_screen: 128 train / 64 validation, 8 epochs, matched seed and readout.
training_ladder.promotion_screen: 1024 train / 256 validation, two seeds, predeclared gate.
training_ladder.scale_screen: 4096 train / 384 calibration and the disjoint offset-384 107-case holdout, five seeds after two-seed promotion; the CubiCasa val split contains only 491 cases.
training_ladder.full_validation: Only after scale promotion; no test-guided tuning.

promoted_generation.readout: boundary-edge graph + confidence-gated owner partition + merged shared-owner wall network; 1 NFE
promoted_generation.note: Wall F1/IoU and dangling improve on all five seeds versus room-polygon walls; room/graph metrics are unchanged.

predicted_control_reasonableness.interpretation: Geometry and legality are serviceable; identity, count, opening recall, and graph consistency are the real blockers.

predicted_control_query_readout_audit.interpretation: Full-resolution query fusion generalizes on the diagnostic subset. Raw query-only masks and existence-gated fusion are not sufficient.

dense_query_blend_fiveseed_hold.decision: Hold. Full-val and complete-structure gates pass, but holdout instance F1 improves on only one of five seeds. Keep blend50 as a seed-specific diagnostic room-identity readout, not a promoted predicted-control SOTA result.
limitations: Opening F1 regresses on all five seeds.
Type accuracy regresses on the offset-128 holdout.
The 256/64 screen has not been promoted to the 1024/256 two-seed rung.

canonical_plan_result.reason: Wall F1 fell by 0.0143 and Room IoU by 0.0007 after canonical wall composition. The visible-plan consumer preserves walls exactly but support/count no longer improve.

selective_support_deletion_hold.lesson: Room-only support gains cannot be promoted before the complete CAD consumer. Keep topology-safe deletion as a room-identity diagnostic and move the budget to an already-trained strong opening consumer.

opening_interval_canonical_cal64.decision: Promote to full val491 opening-consumer integration; do not claim five-seed or external SOTA before robustness.

engineering_fixes: Furniture readout now uses only furniture channels, excluding room and footprint channels.
Predicted furniture is excluded by default because its saturated masks overwrite structural evidence.
The explicit room checkpoint is no longer silently overwritten by decoder warm-start state.
Dual-control fusion initializes to an exact native-image identity.

owner_wall_action_twoseed.room_and_graph: Room IoU, instance F1, Node F1, Edge overlap, and GED are unchanged.
owner_wall_action_twoseed.safety: Validity, watertightness, and opening F1 remain 1.0; dangling is 0.0087-0.0105.
limitations: Connector length is 4.9-8.3% of total wall length.
The action scorer has not passed 1024/256 or five-seed scale.
owner_wall_action_twoseed.decision: Pass the two-seed 128/64 mechanism gate as a small positive branch; do not promote the main claim yet.

owner_wall_action_promotion.failure_reason: The small 128/64 gain did not survive larger training. Action selection regresses both wall metrics on both promotion seeds.
owner_wall_action_promotion.engineering_lesson: Cache frozen-base candidates once; repeated owner-cell extraction made the first 1024 run prohibitively slow.

negative_results.reason: With a frozen base, all 422 non-stage tensors stayed identical, but stage+fusion wall F1/IoU 0.57000/0.37595 did not beat matched control+fusion 0.57058/0.37619. Do not sweep FiLM scale.

negative_results.arm: Dense owner CE / hard owner attention
negative_results.reason: Hard attention and dense owner supervision reduced validation Room IoU or memorized assignments at larger scale.

negative_results.arm: Raw shared_graph with long endpoint repair
negative_results.reason: Connectors accounted for about 18.5% of wall length. Use merged shared_network instead.

negative_results.arm: Post-hoc room count merge / component relabeling
negative_results.reason: Count improved but Room IoU and identity collapsed; identity must be learned jointly with support.
Structure ink split one room into 4-106 fragments and removed 12-34% of support. Best Room IoU was 0.14936 versus 0.26795 baseline; count error rose to 14.89.
Best selection score 0.42839 did not exceed the prior full-resolution query branch. Count improved late, but Room IoU and instance F1 did not improve together.

negative_results.arm: Predicted structural control as the sole room-decoder input
negative_results.reason: The current structure bridge preserves the exterior but misses many interior walls. It is usable only as an auxiliary residual, not as the sole input.
Instance F1 rose from 0.17009 to 0.18773, but Room IoU fell from 0.18893 to 0.18781 and count MAE rose from 3.484 to 3.750. The arm did not pass the joint gate.

negative_results.arm: Teacher-only proposal pretraining plus GT fine-tune
negative_results.reason: Proposal mask IoU improved during pretraining, but the best GT fine-tune had Room IoU 0.18158 and type accuracy 0.45052 versus the native baseline 0.18929/0.47526.

negative_results.arm: Teacher proposal with frozen-geometry class recovery
negative_results.reason: Type accuracy rose to 0.50841 and instance F1 to 0.19388, but Room IoU fell to 0.18388 and count MAE rose to 3.859.
The lightweight boundary head could not separate instances from the final frozen hidden field. Threshold 0.5 was effectively baseline; threshold 0.3 reduced Room IoU and instance F1.
No threshold improved Room IoU, instance F1, and count together. Count is already over-predicted, so a split-only mechanism addresses the wrong failure direction.
Guarded arbitration reached instance F1 0.16666 and count MAE 3.750, but the best composite arm left count unchanged; stronger suppression traded Room IoU for instance metrics.

negative_results.arm: Dense-fragment graph with IoU-0.5 node labels
negative_results.reason: Edge positives vanished and all arbitration arms were no-ops. Dense class fragments are too imprecise to serve as instance nodes.
Query-only Room IoU 0.21560, instance F1 0.22245, count MAE 3.344 beat the best learned graph arm. Query existence thresholds 0.2-0.6 were identical and uncalibrated.
The learned residual gate did not beat fixed blend75. Its support output also had no label-level consumer: room support remained exactly the footprint at every epoch.

The best full-val arm reduced count MAE by 0.564 but lost Room IoU 0.00149 and support IoU 0.01435. Holdout showed the same quality/local-support tradeoff. Only a selective deletion head with a hard preservation region remains viable.
Five-seed val491 and complete-structure gains are positive, but offset-128 instance F1 improves on only 1/5 seeds. Do not pool incompatible slices to convert the candidate into a SOTA claim.

negative_results.arm: Selective support deletion as a complete-CAD gain
negative_results.reason: The room-only gains were strong and paired-significant, but disappeared or reversed after canonical wall composition. Keep the head as room-identity diagnostic until structure-aware training consumes its output during wall/owner learning.
Quality-first and safety-first readouts, oracle and predicted controls, and generation versus editing must never share a row.

same_protocol_sota_blockers.room_identity_and_count: Predicted-control Room macro IoU is 0.2697 despite support IoU 0.7727. Duplicate/fragmented masks and room count dominate the gap.
same_protocol_sota_blockers.wall_precision_and_opening_recall: Wall recall 0.658 but precision 0.360; opening F1 0.083. Wall/opening actions need matched-edge supervision and explicit hosts.
same_protocol_sota_blockers.predicted_controls: Free-text and imperfect-control prediction are not solved by oracle edit-region gains.
same_protocol_sota_blockers.external_execution: HouseMind-E official inference remains unavailable. No direct same-protocol leaderboard gap can be claimed until its tokenizer/serialization/decode/post-processing contract is executable.
same_protocol_sota_blockers.statistics: Five seeds give exact Wilcoxon p=0.0625 for 5/5 consistency. Report paired CIs, ranges, and rank-biserial effect rather than p<0.05.
same_protocol_sota_blockers.test_access: RPLAN and CubiCasa test remain closed until validation evidence, code, thresholds, and baselines are frozen.

pipeline_order: room identity, presence, count, and class
owner cell complex and shared edges
canonical vector assembly and token codec
rules: Each module exposes typed tensor or canonical objects, not hidden mutable arrays.
A downstream consumer must be implemented before a head enters a scientific screen.
A stage may consume only declared upstream state; no direct cross-layer tensor reach-through.
Checkpoint compatibility is proven when a branch is disabled.
Every optional branch records trainable parameters, gradients, NFE, latency, and output consumer.
A negative arm is retained as evidence and removed from runtime promotion, not deleted from the record.
Tests cover shape, masking, gradient flow, disabled path, misordered input, and real-data round trip.

tasks.title: Canonical opening interval integration
actions: Freeze the existing opening_interval_decoder_full_8ep_v1 checkpoint as the only opening candidate; it already improves cal64 canonical Opening F1 from 0.1153 to 0.2815 at threshold 0.3.
Connect the opening heatmap to the same predicted-control structure plan without changing rooms or walls, and verify that opening attachment preserves validity and watertightness.
Run full val491 with the opening consumer and compare against the matched no-opening readout using case-paired bootstrap intervals.
Compare thresholds 0.3 and 0.5 only on calibration64; freeze the selected threshold before full validation and do not tune on val491.

Train or recover matched opening checkpoints for the remaining promotion seeds if the single-seed full-val result passes; report the opening detector parameter/training budget and checkpoint provenance.
Integrate the accepted opening heatmap path into CadStageRuntime and the final structure evaluator, replacing only the opening layer.
Keep selective support deletion out of the promoted complete-CAD row until support supervision is consumed during owner/wall learning.

gate.primary: Canonical Opening F1 improves over the matched no-opening plan with a paired interval excluding zero.
gate.non_regression: Room, wall, furniture, validity, watertightness, outside-footprint, and graph metrics do not regress.
gate.stability: Threshold selection happens on calibration only; full val491 and any later holdout are frozen before evaluation.
gate.engineering: The opening checkpoint, threshold, host geometry, attachment distance, and evaluator SHA-256 are recorded; the consumer preserves non-opening layers.
gate.honesty: This is an opening-consumer integration result, not complete-CAD or HouseMind SOTA.

tasks.failure_response: If canonical Opening F1 gains do not survive full validation, return to host-wall supervision. Do not hide wall or graph regressions behind an opening-only claim.

tasks.title: Matched same-protocol baselines and paired statistics
actions: Freeze executable CE2EPlan, Raster2Seq, TLC-Plan, and HouseMind rows only where the official contract exists.
Label generation-only, reconstruction, oracle-control, predicted-control, and free-text rows separately.
Report parameters, optimizer steps, sample exposure, NFE, latency, and peak memory.
Run paired bootstrap intervals, Wilcoxon tests, and rank-biserial effects on case-level metrics.
Record unavailable HouseMind rows as unavailable, never as zero.

gate.match: Inputs, split, preprocessing, evaluator, and post-processing are identical within each row.
gate.claim: At least one primary metric improves with a paired interval excluding zero and no structural regression.
gate.honesty: Unmatched or unavailable rows cannot enter a leaderboard claim.

tasks.failure_response: Return to the failing protocol stage; do not weaken the evaluator or pool incompatible tasks.

tasks.title: Five-seed RPLAN validation and frozen test
actions: Run five seeds on the final RPLAN architecture and full validation.
Freeze code, checkpoint, thresholds, readout, baselines, and statistics before test access.
Run the RPLAN test once with no subsequent tuning.
Keep generation and editing claims in separate tables.

gate.stability: All five seeds preserve validity, watertightness, and the promoted architecture gain.
gate.evidence: Every reported test value maps to a frozen artifact and command.

tasks.failure_response: Keep test closed and return to validation.

tasks.title: CubiCasa complete-CAD and matched external evaluation
actions: Use official Raster2Seq preprocessing and keep raster metrics separate from official vector metrics.
Require learned wall, opening, host, furniture, and junction consumers in the canonical plan.
Run matched Raster2Seq evaluation with declared parameters and budgets.
Stratify by room count, small rooms, walls, openings, and furniture density.

gate.absolute: Room IoU 0.72, instance F1 0.85, wall F1 0.80, opening F1 0.75, furniture F1 0.70, watertightness 0.98.
gate.matched: Official baseline on the same cases and evaluator.
gate.safety: No oracle controls in the deployable row.

tasks.failure_response: Diagnose the failing layer/data contract; never substitute adapter scores for official metrics.

tasks.title: Predicted-control strict-locality and free-text editing
actions: Predict edit regions and typed actions without oracle regions.
Keep outside projection as an independent certificate, not an unmeasured assumption.
Train text parsing and abstention only after predicted controls are stable.
Compare only against fully executable editing baselines.
Report oracle-control, control-gated, predicted-control, and free-text rows separately.

gate.editing: Delta-IoU at least 0.95, Delta-MSE at most 0.0019, Node F1 at least 0.98, edge overlap at least 0.93, GED at most 0.5.
gate.external: HouseMind direct comparison only with a complete matched inference contract.

tasks.failure_response: Keep free-text disabled if predicted controls are not stable; do not relabel typed parsing as SOTA.

tasks.title: Final evidence freeze and reproducibility package
actions: Run full non-chips tests, Ruff, 600-line checks, JSON validation, manifest and SHA-256 verification.
Map every number to one generator script and source artifact.
Freeze a protocol matrix distinguishing generation, reconstruction, oracle, predicted, free-text, and unavailable.
Exclude chips/FloorSet artifacts.

gate.evidence: No orphan metric or stale intermediate artifact.

tasks.failure_response: Disable the unsupported claim or repair the evidence chain.
